**Finding: INSURANCE — missing (preferred-level insert proposed).**

- **Investigation:** Full-document searches for "insurance" and coverage/certificate language returned nothing. § 20 General Matters (p0135–p0147, p0149–p0150) covers time of essence, notices, waiver, assignment, independent contractor, force majeure, severability, governing law, headings and entire agreement — no insurance covenant. The on-site/implementation provisions (§ 4 delivery, installation and conversion of Sparkling's data; § 9 co-operation and implementation) confirm Garman both processes our data and works with our organisation, so the rule expects insurance and its absence is walk-away territory.
- **Cure:** One `insert_after` p0149 adding § 20(k) with CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber and privacy USD 5M where Garman processes any data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Sparkling (drafted broadly since this Agreement has no defined "Customer Data"), statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request. No survival tail, expense language or other non-element boilerplate was added; the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) is offered in the comment.
